subject: Copywriting
title: Subject Lines: The Email Headline
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Subject Lines: The Email Headline.

hook.text: Obama's 2012 campaign raised $690 million by email. The top-performing subject line was just one word: 'Hey.'

buildup.text: Email subject lines are headlines for the inbox. 47% of recipients decide to open based solely on the subject.

discovery.text: Personal, casual subjects outperform formal ones. 'Quick question' beats 'Important Business Update' every time.

twist.text: The 'Hey' subject worked once. When everyone copied it, open rates crashed. Every trick has a shelf life.

climax.text: Great subject lines follow headline rules: specificity, curiosity, and a clear promise of value inside.

punchline.text: One word: 'Hey.' $690M raised. Subject lines matter.

quiz.question: What was the top-performing email subject line for Obama's campaign?
